intro: Philip Dimka is a clinical psychologist, trauma therapist and play therapist based in Jos, Plateau State, Nigeria. He works with adults, adolescents, children and families, and trains the people who care for them.
story_title: Why this work matters to me
story:
My journey into psychology began with a desire to understand people, their experiences, and the things that shape who they become. Through my work with children, adolescents, and families, I came to appreciate how deeply childhood experiences and trauma can influence emotional well-being, relationships, and development. I also discovered the remarkable capacity people have to heal and grow when they are met with understanding, safety, and the right support.

This inspired my commitment to trauma therapy, children and adult mental health, and play therapy. As a Clinical Psychologist and Trauma Therapist, I bring together clinical practice, research, training, and community engagement to help people find their voices, equip caregivers to respond with compassion, and create environments where healing can happen.

Much of my work is rooted in one belief: **people are more than their experiences, and their past does not have to determine their future.** My hope is to help individuals, families, and communities find the understanding, support, and courage they need to heal, grow, and thrive.
